MU.idea: WATCH, not STARTER/BUY — -21.4% price collapse pulled MoS to a nominal 14.5% (close to Gate) but: (1) Cyclical tier is excluded from Starter mechanism regardless of MoS, (2) ER on corrected formula fails badly (-7.2%/yr, cyclical mean-reversion), (3) Lynch Peak signals from last batch still active.
risk: Memory highly cyclical; SK Hynix/Samsung HBM capacity race (parity ~40% each by 2027 vs MU ~20-25%); CapEx heavy ($25B FY26, step-up FY27); Netlist/YMTC patent litigation overhang; SCA floor reduces but doesn't eliminate cyclicality.
bull: HBM sole-US-supplier margin สูง + AI memory demand จริง structural (KV-cache, agentic AI) + now $22B SCA confirmation adds to the ~$100B floor — but the sharp price drop this week is a sentiment/rotation event on a peak-cycle name, not confirmation of a genuine entry point; cyclical peak EPS ยังห้าม extrapolate เป็น base.

story_gate.what: Micron is the sole US-based HBM memory supplier for NVIDIA Vera Rubin/GB200 AI systems, with entire calendar-2026 HBM supply priced & committed through LTA/SCA contracts, benefiting from agentic AI's KV-cache problem that drives structural HBM+NAND demand simultaneously.
story_gate.why: Consensus is repricing MU down hard (-21.4% in days, from $1,250 to $983.12) alongside the broad July AI/semi selloff (SK Hynix HBM capacity-growth deceleration reports, Fed hawkishness, AI-ROI doubt) — treating memory names as the most exposed to an AI-capex pullback; Warren agrees the $22B customer agreement confirmation (07-13) is genuine incremental de-risking evidence, but the price collapse is far larger than any single fundamental data point explains, and MU was already flagged last batch with all 3 Lynch Peak signals active (analyst upgrades, cover narrative, peak-EPS-driven low P/E) — a sharp drawdown from a peak-earnings high on a Cyclical name is not automatically a buying signal under the counter-intuitive Cyclical rule (buy at high/loss P/E, sell at peak-earnings low P/E).
story_gate.risk: Samsung/SK Hynix HBM capacity ramp faster than LTA/SCA buffer absorbs, forcing price capitulation; OR AI hyperscaler CapEx decelerates materially confirming the July selloff's thesis; OR FQ4 earnings (~Sept 2026) miss the $50B/$31 guide.

verified_claims: Price cross-check Nasdaq+CNBC (0% drift): $904.28 — down a FURTHER 8.02% intraday since Warren's card was written at $983.12 (which itself was already -21.4% off ATH); cumulative pullback from the $1,255 ATH is now ~28%, reinforcing the WATCH stance

Warren's use of a long-horizon mean-reverting -10.4%/yr growth figure (vs raw near-term consensus, which independently checks out at +32-36%/yr — heavily inflated by the current AI/HBM upcycle base effect off a depressed FY2025 trough) is methodologically consistent with the house Cyclical Peak EPS Bias policy (no Peak EPS × normal multiple for cyclicals) — sound, appropriately conservative, not a miscalibration

SOLS.idea: ⚠️ MATERIAL EVENT: On 2026-07-06 SOLS signed a definitive $14.5B cash-and-stock agreement to acquire Element Solutions (ESI) — 0.5 SOLS sh + $10 cash per ESI share, ESI holders end up owning ~44% of the combined company, $4.7B Goldman Sachs bridge financing, expected close H1 2027. Stock fell -28% (~$85→$61) on dilution/leverage fears. Mechanically MoS (30.6%), PEG (0.98) and ER (31.2%/yr) all clear BUY gates on STANDALONE fair value — but Warren OVERRIDES to WATCH: FV Base does not price in post-merger dilution/debt, deal terms aren't final before H1 2027 close, and there's no genuine variant view vs. the market's dilution concern (management's own accretion claim isn't independent evidence). Flag to Oat — judgment call, Charlie should review closely.
risk: Nuclear policy reversal; Metropolis IL radiation litigation (class-cert/summary judgment rulings expected 2026); Element Solutions deal risk (fails to close / repriced / integration disappoints vs. promised year-1 EPS accretion + $180M synergies by yr3); new ~$4.7B leverage; standalone public-company cost drag; Building Solutions exposure.

story_gate.why: ⚠️ **Material event ใหม่ตั้งแต่ gate ก่อน:** 6 ก.ค. 2026 SOLS เซ็น definitive agreement ซื้อ Element Solutions (ESI) ด้วยเงิน+หุ้น ~$14.5B (ESI ผู้ถือหุ้นได้ 0.5 หุ้น SOLS + เงินสด $10/หุ้น ESI, ผู้ถือ ESI จะครอง ~44% ของบริษัทรวม, bridge financing $4.7B จาก Goldman Sachs, คาดปิดดีล H1 2027 รอ shareholder vote + antitrust) — ราคาร่วง -15% วันประกาศและร่วงต่อเนื่องจนถึง -28% จากช่วงก่อนประกาศ (ตลาดกังวล dilution จาก stock-funded deal + หนี้ใหม่ $4.7B); CEO Sewell บอกว่าตลาด overreact เป็น "speculative trading" — **แต่นั่นคือคำพูดฝ่ายบริหาร ไม่ใช่หลักฐาน** Warren ไม่มี edge ที่ต่างจาก consensus ในเรื่องนี้ (ไม่มีข้อมูล primary ยืนยันว่า accretion claim ปีแรก + synergy $180M ปีที่ 3 จะเป็นจริง) — core nuclear/UF6 thesis ยังเหมือนเดิม แต่ภาพระยะสั้นตอนนี้ถูกครอบด้วยดีล M&A ขนาดใหญ่ที่ยังไม่แน่นอนเป็นเวลาเกือบ 1 ปี

verified_claims: Price cross-checked Nasdaq+CNBC (0% drift): $61.03 both sources, exact match to Warren's card

M&A deal terms independently verified 100% accurate via SEC 8-K/425 filings and the company's own press release: $14.5B cash-and-stock deal for Element Solutions, $10 cash + 0.500 SOLS shares per ESI share (~$50.10/share implied, ~15% premium to 7/2 close), ESI holders end up owning ~44% of combined co, >$180M net synergies within 3 years, expected close H1 2027 — every figure on Warren's card matches primary sources exactly

Metropolis, IL radiation litigation risk independently confirmed real: 8 lawsuits already settled in 2024 over Honeywell-era radiation exposure claims, plus an active suit from the City/County of Metropolis alleging contamination, property damage and personal injury — matches Warren's thesis_risk verbatim

Warren's WATCH override (despite all 4 numeric gates technically passing on a standalone basis) is independently endorsed — a $14.5B deal with $4.7B of new bridge financing and a pending shareholder-vote/regulatory timeline through H1 2027 is a legitimate reason not to mechanically BUY off a pre-merger fair value

Given both sources are thin/low-analyst-count for a name that's both a recent spinoff and mid-acquisition, treat this as a data-quality flag rather than a confirmed Warren error
Charlie FV = consensus FY27 EPS $3.23 x Warren's stated forward PE 23.0x = ~$74 vs Warren's $88 base — an 18.4% gap, just under the 20% mandatory threshold but close enough to flag

Extremely limited standalone operating/trading history — SOLS itself only completed its Honeywell spinoff in Oct 2025 and is already announcing a transformative $14.5B acquisition within its first year as a standalone public company, which constrains how much confidence any Fair Value or tier assignment can carry independent of deal-execution risk (Warren already cut RA score 5.5->4.5 for this, appropriately)
